prompt:
Use case: product-mockup.
Asset type: photorealistic square catalog image for Home Gym Creator.
Primary request: Separate single-column cable machine, in the same catalog art direction as the existing compact dual-pulley station.
Input image 1: EQUIPMENT FORM REFERENCE ONLY. Retain the narrow wall-anchored single-column arrangement, not a manufacturer's design or branding.
Input image 2: STYLE REFERENCE ONLY. Match graphite powder-coated steel, brushed steel, black cables and handles, small orange adjustment controls, warm off-white studio background and premium product photography. Do NOT reproduce its wide dual-column structure or pull-up bar.
Subject: One complete tall narrow cable column. A single brushed-steel front adjustment rail with evenly spaced round holes and ONE height-adjustable swivel pulley carriage at mid-chest height. Two black D-handles on short webbing straps hang from outlets on this same carriage, fed by one selectorized resistance stack, not two independent stations. Behind the front rail, one visible stack of black rectangular weight plates, two polished guide rods, a slender graphite rear upright and compact upper pulley return assembly with plausibly connected black cables. Small graphite T-shaped floor base with rubber end pads. Clearly visible short rear wall-attachment brackets near upper and lower rear upright; the isolated product presentation must not suggest the small feet alone make it safely freestanding. No wall or gym room in shot. Original unbranded hardware design with plausible bolts, brackets, welds and metal thickness. Restrained orange carriage locking knob and stack selector pin.
Style: convincing real studio catalog product photography, crisp powder-coat texture and subtle metal reflections, soft diffused light, natural contact shadow. Not illustration or a simplified 3D render.
Composition: square canvas, full machine centered, front three-quarter camera with enough side visibility to see the single rear weight stack and wall brackets, straight verticals, entire base and top visible, product about 86 percent of canvas height, generous clean space left and right.
Avoid: second column, second adjustment rail, second weight stack, integrated pull-up bar, overhead wide crossbar, bench, seat or thigh restraint, rack, unrelated accessories, people, text, logos, numbers, weight labels, diagrams, watermarks, floating hardware, disconnected or tangled cables. Do not depict or claim dimensions, weight ratings, certified cable ratios or safe installation. Generate one image.
review: Visually inspected generated image: one narrow front adjustment rail and carriage with two hanging handles, one rear selectorized stack with guide rods, upper cable-return assembly, small base and visible rear wall brackets. Graphite and brushed-metal finish, restrained orange knobs, complete object against warm off-white studio background; no visible branding or text. AI-generated concept only, not evidence of physical cable routing, independent resistance channels, dimensions, load ratings or safe mounting.
status: Concept image saved, not mapped to a catalog product. Loop identity and saved-project data unchanged. Product specification, compatibility, model and integration remain separate work.
